title: The Wrong Key
setting: A clothes shop in town and the front door of the uncle's small house.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a young girl with long black hair and a red sweater

characters.name: Uncle
characters.look: Uncle, a tall man with glasses and a green shirt

sentences.en: Dan and Aiko spend the day with their uncle.
sentences.zh: 丹和爱子跟叔叔一起过了一天。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt and Aiko, a young girl with long black hair and a red sweater walk down a sunny street with Uncle, a tall man with glasses and a green shirt.

sentences.en: The jeans Dan wears are too short now.
sentences.zh: 丹穿的牛仔裤现在太短了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt stands in jeans that end high above his ankles, looking down at them.

sentences.en: So their uncle buys him a new pair.
sentences.zh: 于是叔叔给他买了一条新的。
sentences.scene_prompt: In a clothes shop, Uncle, a tall man with glasses and a green shirt pays for a folded pair of blue jeans while Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt smiles.

sentences.en: At home, their uncle has a big problem.
sentences.zh: 到家后，叔叔遇到了一个大问题。
sentences.scene_prompt: Uncle, a tall man with glasses and a green shirt stands at the closed front door of his small house, frowning, with Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt and Aiko, a young girl with long black hair and a red sweater beside him.

sentences.en: But his key is wrong for the door.
sentences.zh: 可是他的钥匙跟这扇门不配。
sentences.scene_prompt: Uncle, a tall man with glasses and a green shirt tries to turn a key that does not fit in the lock of the front door.

sentences.en: Aiko speaks up: “Look above the door!”
sentences.zh: 爱子大声说：“看门的上方！”
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with long black hair and a red sweater points up at a small key lying on the frame above the front door.

sentences.en: They all go into the house and feel better.
sentences.zh: 他们都走进屋里，感觉好多了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Uncle, a tall man with glasses and a green shirt, Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt and Aiko, a young girl with long black hair and a red sweater walk happily through the open front door into the house.

sentences.en: Dan shows Aiko his new jeans with a smile.
sentences.zh: 丹笑着给爱子看他的新牛仔裤。
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside the house, Dan, a young boy with brown hair and a blue T-shirt proudly shows his new blue jeans to Aiko, a young girl with long black hair and a red sweater.
